script:
John (Gang Member)
Congratulations, you have become John
You are a loyal subordinate, at least that's how it appears to others. You and your boss Johnny were arrested together on December 11th last year for a failed murder case. Originally you were imprisoned with Johnny in the same cell 1602, but three months later, another of Johnny's subordinates, Ken, was imprisoned for a weapons fight. Johnny expressed that he wanted to live alone, so he signaled you to live with Ken - two people could take care of each other. After all, your gang has too many enemies and might be oppressed by others in prison. You complied, so shortly after Ken was imprisoned, you bribed the guard and moved into 1601 with Ken.
Ken's mental state has been unstable since imprisonment, often showing symptoms of emotional loss of control and would frantically attack others. After you taught him a few lessons, he became somewhat more obedient, but according to the prison doctor's diagnosis, Ken has schizophrenia and his episodes are very unstable - probably too stimulated by being arrested. Johnny didn't pay much attention to this matter. He relied on bribing guard Steven and still controlled his gang, occasionally having him bring some "outside things" to improve his life.
On the night the boss died, you went to sleep quickly after dinner. Ken, not knowing if he was having an episode again, attacked you while you were sleeping. You quickly fought back. During the struggle, you accidentally broke the wall clock, and the glass fragments that splattered out injured your hand. After a few moves, you quickly subdued Ken and then went back to sleep.
Learning of the boss's death made you very angry. You don't think the boss was the type to give up on life, so his death must have other reasons. You really want to find out, but you also learned that the boss indicated in his suicide note that he hoped you would take his position. If the boss was murdered, then someone might be trying to frame you. You must find the real killer.
Your Dark Side:
In the underworld, you are an obedient subordinate. Boss Johnny also values you highly and often takes you to important occasions. But everyone has their own ambitions. You were bought by another gang boss, Owen, who gave you a large sum of money to work as an undercover agent lurking beside Johnny. He also gave you a token, but you forgot where you put it. What you had to do was sell information, so your gang was doing poorly for several months. That's why Johnny wanted to negotiate with other gangs. Actually, the December operation was Johnny personally going to negotiate with Owen and looking for an opportunity to assassinate him, but it failed precisely because of your tip-off. But you disguised it well and were arrested and imprisoned together with Johnny, so you weren't suspected. Since then, Owen has also expressed hope that you could eliminate Johnny and take his position, but you remained noncommittal.
Character Relationships:

Guard Steven - A guard who bullies the weak and fears the strong, loves small gains. He frequently interacts with Johnny and reportedly gave Johnny many "private jobs"
1601 Ken - Your cellmate who has mental illness. You've fought multiple times, but it seems just because of his episodes. You don't mind much but keep some distance from him
1603 Andrew - A crazy heretic, at least in your view, always acting crazy
1603 Clark - You know little about him, only that he's very strong but doesn't like to talk. From Johnny's attitude toward him, it seems they've had conflicts
Janitor George - A kind middle-aged man. Only he can enter and exit Johnny's cell daily because of cleaning duties

Your Statement to the Detective:
Respected Detective:
My boss is dead, and I'm very sad now. Please finish questioning quickly, okay? Last night I was very sleepy, so I went to bed early and didn't hear any abnormal sounds. But that kid Ken seemed to have another episode and came to fight with me in the middle of the night. Although I quickly beat him into submission, I'm used to these things. But if you really want to ask if there was anything special, that's the only thing. When was the last time I saw the boss? Let me think... Oh, I saw the boss during recreation time a few days ago and chatted with him briefly, roughly about how to adjust some internal matters after we get out. But now the boss is dead and he gave me his position. I find this very strange. The boss wasn't the type to give up on life. This suicide note might very well be used by someone else to frame me. But the handwriting... is indeed the boss's own. I personally know the boss's handwriting - although I'm the person who has had the most contact with the boss's signed documents, I hope you believe me. I'm so loyal to him - how could I possibly kill the boss? Ken can also testify that we were both in our cell last night, and how could we get out of the cell anyway? In short, if this really is a murder case, I hope you can solve it quickly. I want to tear apart this killer. That's all I have to say.
acts_goal:
Find Johnny's killer
Guard your dark side
